d: stc Kuwait is actively recruiting for the role of Digital Channels Analyst, In this role, you will supports the translation of business objectives into digital channel solutions. Working under the guidance of the Digital Channels Executive Analyst and management, the role performs requirements gathering and documentation, journey and process mapping, backlog support, test preparation and execution, and channel performance reporting across the customer-facing, self-service, conversational and internal digital workplace channels.
your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following:
Gather and document business requirements, user stories, process flows, and customer journeys for digital channel initiatives.
Manage and improve digital channels and automation, including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, self-service, and conversational channels.
Support testing and quality assurance, including UAT, test scenarios, defect tracking, and business sign-off.
Monitor and analyze digital channel performance and KPIs, identifying improvement opportunities based on customer behavior and feedback.
Coordinate with business, technical teams, and vendors, while ensuring requirements meet regulatory, security, privacy, and brand standards.
To apply to this role, please make sure that you meet the following criteria:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

The ISO & ICV Executive plays a key role in maintaining the organization's ISO management systems and ICV requirements. This position ensures that all documentation, processes, records, and supporting evidence are up-to-date and audit-ready. Working closely with Finance and other departments, the ISO & ICV Executive monitors compliance, coordinates audits, documents processes, and follows up on corrective actions. The role supports management in enhancing internal controls, improving processes, and maintaining records necessary for certification, audit, and ICV submissions, contributing to the overall governance and compliance framework of the organization.
q: Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems and internal audit methodology.
Proficiency in SOP and process documentation and records control.
Experience with ICV requirements and supporting documentation.
Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
What Qualifies You For The Role
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Quality Management, Engineering, or related discipline.
ISO 9001 Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor training.
3-5 years of relevant experience in ISO, quality systems, internal controls, audit, finance compliance, or ICV-related activities.
Experience in a multi-department organization within the automotive, trading, distribution, or service industry.
Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.
With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.

Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.

Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.

Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.
For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.
r: Coordinate the implementation and ongoing maintenance of applicable ISO management systems, particularly ISO 9001 and any other standards adopted by the organization.
Maintain ISO policies, procedures, process maps, work instructions, forms, and supporting documentation.
Manage the document-control system, including version control, approvals, and distribution of controlled documents.
Coordinate periodic review of departmental procedures and ensure documents remain current.
Support departments in documenting new processes or changes to existing processes.
Maintain the ISO compliance calendar and track certification, surveillance, and internal audit requirements.
Coordinate ISO internal audits across departments.
Prepare audit schedules, documentation, and supporting evidence.
Liaise with external certification bodies and auditors.
Maintain records of audit findings, observations, and non-conformities.
Coordinate with responsible departments to develop and track Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
Follow up outstanding audit actions and escalate overdue items to management.
Maintain an audit-action tracker and periodically report the status of open items.
Coordinate preparation of information and supporting documentation required for ICV certification/submissions applicable to the business.
Work closely with Finance, Procurement, HR, and other functions to collect required financial and operational information.
Maintain supporting documents for ICV-related calculations and verification.
Coordinate with external ICV auditors/certifiers where applicable.
Reconcile ICV submissions to underlying financial and operational records.
Identify opportunities to improve the organization's ICV position through better documentation, sourcing visibility, and data quality.
Maintain historical ICV submissions, certifications, and supporting files for audit purposes.
Support Finance in reviewing key business processes and internal controls.
Document Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process flows, and control activities.
Identify gaps in processes or documentation and recommend practical improvements.
Assist departments in implementing corrective actions arising from audits and control reviews.
Support initiatives to standardize processes and strengthen governance.
Maintain evidence demonstrating that key controls and procedures are being followed.
Support Finance during internal audit, external audit, and other compliance reviews.
Coordinate supporting documents requested by auditors.
Maintain structured documentation and audit trails for key compliance activities.
Follow up departments for outstanding audit information and supporting documents.
Assist in reconciliations and validation of financial information used for ICV or compliance purposes.
Maintain appropriate trackers for audit findings, compliance requirements, and management actions.

Prepare periodic management updates covering ISO certification status, internal audit completion, external audit findings, open non-conformities, CAPA status, overdue corrective actions, ICV certification/submission status, documentation gaps, key compliance risks.
Maintain a centralized ISO / ICV / Audit Action Tracker with clear ownership, target dates, and completion status.

d: PxGeo is an international offshore geophysical services company providing seismic data acquisition and related services to the energy industry. The Group operates across multiple jurisdictions with a head office in Dubai and manages projects in a complex and highly regulated environment.

PxGeo’s operations involve an extensive international supply chain, including vessel chartering, specialist equipment and technology, offshore services, logistics, and a broad range of suppliers and contractors. The Legal function supports commercial arrangements across multiple countries and legal frameworks, with a significant proportion of the Group’s contracts governed by English law.
Official job title is Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting and will be based in Dubai, UAE.
This position provides senior-level legal support to PxGeo’s commercial, operational and Supply Chain activities.

The role will take ownership of complex and strategically important commercial agreements, provide practical and commercially focused legal advice throughout the contracting lifecycle, and support the development of consistent contracting standards across the Group.

The successful candidate will work closely with Operations, Technical Solutions, Finance, Supply Chain, Sales and other business functions. The role requires the ability to lead contractual negotiations independently, identify and communicate material legal and commercial risks, and develop workable solutions that support PxGeo’s operational objectives while appropriately protecting the Group’s interests. Key responsibilities include:
Lead the drafting, review and negotiation of complex, high-value and strategically significant commercial agreements.
Provide legal support in connection with contracts relating to:
offshore and seismic services; vessel chartering and marine services;
specialist equipment and technology; equipment supply, rental, hire and leasing;
agency, logistics, freight and transportation; consultancy and contractor services;
software, technology and licensing; framework and master services agreements;
purchase orders and associated contractual documentation; and
Lead negotiations with customers, suppliers, contractors and other commercial counterparties.
Review and negotiate amendments to PxGeo’s Terms & Conditions.
Review and negotiate counterparties’ standard terms where PxGeo’s contractual documentation cannot be used.
Advise on contractual structures and appropriate risk allocation, including:
liability and indemnities; consequential and indirect loss;
warranties and performance obligations; insurance requirements;
intellectual property and data rights; payment and security arrangements;
delivery, acceptance and delay; liquidated damages;
regulatory compliance; governing law and dispute resolution.
Provide practical advice on contractual interpretation, contract performance and operational issues arising during project delivery.
Support the management and resolution of commercial claims and disputes before escalation to formal proceedings.
Coordinate with external legal counsel where specialist or jurisdiction-specific advice is required.
Act as a senior Legal point of contact for commercial and operational matters.
Work closely with business teams to understand the technical, operational and commercial context of proposed arrangements.
Participate in project, tender and negotiation meetings where legal input is required.
Support the identification and management of contractual risks during the tendering, negotiation, mobilisation and performance stages.
Advise management on material contractual exposures and available mitigation measures.
Support the development of negotiation strategies for complex or sensitive matters.
Promote early engagement with Legal so that material risks are identified before commercial positions are agreed.
Support the development, maintenance and implementation of PxGeo’s standard contracts, templates, contractual guidance and fallback positions.
Contribute to the standardisation and continuous improvement of commercial contracting processes.
Support efficient workflows and escalation routes between Legal and other functions.
Provide guidance and support to Legal Counsel/Paralegal and other members of the Legal team on commercial contracting matters.
Deliver practical training to relevant business functions on contractual risk and contracting procedures.
Support with other commercial, corporate or strategic matters as required.
q: Qualified lawyer with substantial 9+ post-qualification experience, although the quality and relevance of experience will be more important than the precise number of years.

Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LLB) or Master’s Degree in Law (LLM). English law qualification is desirable but not essential, provided the candidate has strong practical experience with common law commercial contracts.
Strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex commercial agreements governed by English law or based on English common law principles.
Demonstrated ability to lead contractual negotiations independently and engage effectively with senior internal stakeholders and external counterparties.
Detailed understanding of commercial risk allocation.
Ability to understand technical and operational requirements and translate them into workable contractual arrangements.
Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish material legal risks from matters that can be managed operationally.
Ability to manage multiple complex and time-sensitive matters with limited supervision.
Experience in one or more of the following would be advantageous:
energy or oil and gas; offshore services; seismic or geophysical services; marine or shipping; vessel chartering; procurement and Supply Chain contracting; or international project-based operations.
Previous in-house experience within an international, operational or project-based organisation would be a strong advantage.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a general track for Senior+ (Senior/Staff/Principal) Engineers in any team at Canonical. After the first round of interviews we will establish which teams might be an excellent fit, and progress your application with them.

At Canonical a Senior+ Engineer is not only an outstanding software architect and coder, they also demonstrate the leadership qualities needed to rally a team or department to ship outstanding products. A Senior+ Engineer partners with other Engineering leaders (Managers, Directors, VPs) to take joint responsibility for outcomes at team, department and company level. We hire based on academic results and proven execution, and we select those with a passion for open-source software, innovation, and cutting-edge technology. In this role, you will make a significant contribution in Canonical's portfolio through high-quality code, technical leadership, team motivation and direction, exceptional design, and crisp documentation.

As a Senior+ Engineer you'll drive the architecture, design and evolution of high-impact open source software. Our teams work at every level of the stack. From the kernel and system software at the core of Ubuntu through to major language runtimes and the bleeding-edge of cloud automation and distributed systems, you'll have the opportunity to work on complex but highly rewarding projects. Our teams also build the services which deliver Ubuntu to the world, on cloud, devices, servers and PCs.

Additionally, this role will give you the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and ensure seamless software operations at scale.
Location: we have remote opportunities for Senior Engineers in every time zone.
Leading design and architecture of an impactful open source project
Coding in Golang, Rust, Python, C/C++ or Typescript / React
Collaborating proactively with a globally distributed team
Mentoring, developing and advising colleagues in their career progression
Displaying technical leadership in Canonical and our communities
Debugging issues and producing high-quality code to fix them
Contributing to technical documentation with the aim to make it the best of its kind
Working from home with global travel twice annually for company events
What we are looking for in you
An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
Technical leadership as well as team motivation, direction and pace
Deep experience with at least one of Go, Rust, Python or C
Conscientiousness and detail orientation, with a focus on performance
Excellent communication skills including professional written and spoken English
Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Depending on your eventual team, you might also bring experience with
Container technologies such as LXD, Docker and Kubernetes
Performance engineering – from kernel to web – benchmarks, optimization
Software security – fuzzing, tabletop threat models, analysis, audit
Build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
Systems programming or scalable web services
SQL and NoSQL data store expertise

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit globally and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

AHS is a Dubai-based group focused on ultra-luxury real estate development, strategic investments, and high-value ventures. With a portfolio centered on high-value assets and complex operations, the business takes a detail-driven approach to financial stewardship, planning, and performance.

Within this environment, the maritime side of the business requires rigorous financial oversight, clear reporting, and close coordination across operational teams to support smooth day-to-day management.

As Yacht Accountant, you will play a key role in supporting the financial control and planning behind yacht operations. This role is suited to someone who is comfortable working across detailed accounting activity and broader financial coordination, helping ensure accuracy, visibility, and informed decision-making across yacht-related operations.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related field.
At least five years of accounting experience in yacht or luxury asset accounting.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with experience using Zoho and Microsoft 365.
Strong knowledge of maritime financial practices, tax regulations, and reporting requirements.
r: Maintain accurate financial records for yacht operating, maintenance, and crew expenses.
Prepare monthly financial statements, budgets, forecasts, and variance analyses.
Manage accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, and timely vendor payments.
Coordinate with yacht management teams to support financial and operational planning.
